value: The stressor caused widespread deactivations of the limbic and paralimbic systems.

We found significantly greater deactivation during stress in the medial PFC, medial temporal lobe including hippocampus and amygdala, posterior insula and posterior putamen, posterior cingulate cortex, and a large bilateral peak involving the nucleus accumbens, ventral pallidum and putamen, adjacent extended amygdala, including the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis, and hypothalamus.
